_README: How a practice exam is composed, per bank, so a session mirrors the real paper
instead of drawing at random across subjects.
`subject` must match the middle field of a question's `origin` exactly. build.py
validates every entry against the built banks and FAILS if a subject is missing or
has fewer questions than `count` — a typo here would otherwise silently produce a
short or empty section.
`pass_mark` is per subject, as the real exams require: passing overall while failing
one subject is still a fail, so the results page scores each subject separately.
A bank with no entry here (cfa_fra) falls back to drawing QUIZ_SIZE at random.
`note` is shown to the user on the results page, so keep it in Traditional Chinese.
cfa_fra has no exam sessions to mirror, so its paper is a full-length drill sized to
one CFA Level I session (90 questions). CFA Institute publishes topic-area weights but
not module-level ones, so the section sizes are proportional to this bank's own coverage
of the Financial Statement Analysis curriculum — stated rather than implied. It carries
no pass_mark: the CFA minimum passing score is not published, and there is no per-topic
one, so the results page shows section scores without a pass/fail verdict.
build.py also FAILS when a subject draws from a pool thinner than 3x, because a
paper that cannot vary is not practice — at 2x, two sittings exhaust the pool and
half of every paper repeats the one before. The subjects in `_thin_ok` are the
known exceptions: their draw is the real paper size and the pool is every question
that has been collected so far, so the only fix is more questions. Listing one here
is a decision to ship it thin; a subject that becomes thin without being listed is
a build failure.

securities.note: 依簡章：第1節 投資學 50 題、第2節 財務分析 50 題、第3節 證券交易相關法規與實務 50 題，共 150 題。

securities_rep.note: 正式的證券商業務員測驗為 100 題：證券交易相關法規與實務 50、證券投資與財務分析 50。本題庫目前只收錄前者，故此處等同「證券交易相關法規與實務乙科」測驗（50 題）。

subjects.subject: 證券交易相關法規與實務

sitca.note: 正式的投信投顧業務員（三科）測驗為 150 題：投信投顧相關法規 50、證券投資與財務分析 50、證券交易相關法規與實務 50。本題庫目前只收錄「投信投顧相關法規」一科，故此處等同該科乙科測驗（50 題）。

cfa_fra.exam: CFA Level I — Financial Reporting & Analysis
cfa_fra.note: Full-length drill: 90 questions, the length of one CFA Level I exam session. Section sizes follow this bank's coverage of the Financial Statement Analysis curriculum, since CFA Institute publishes topic-area weights but not module-level ones. On the real exam, Financial Statement Analysis is roughly 11-14% of 180 questions — about 20-25 questions, not 90.

finance_ethics.exam: 金融市場常識與職業道德
finance_ethics.note: 證基會官方 1,120 題題庫（113 年 9 月 1 日起適用）。依簡章：每回 100 題單選題，每題 1 分，金融市場常識與職業道德各佔 50%，合格分數 70 分。本測驗為單科，故以總分計算及格與否，不分科判定。

futures_trust.exam: 期貨信託基金銷售機構銷售人員
futures_trust.note: 證基會歷屆試題。依簡章：一節，期貨信託法規及自律規範 50 題，測驗成績應達 70 分為合格。

subjects.subject: 期貨信託法規及自律規範

internal_control.exam: 企業內部控制基本能力測驗
internal_control.note: 證基會歷屆試題。依簡章：每回 80 題單選題，每題 1.25 分，合格 70 分。官方出題配比為「內部控制理論與實務」75%、「內部控制相關法規」25%（即 60：20），但答案卷只標示一個科目名稱，題目本身無從分辨屬於哪一部分，故此處以單一科目抽 80 題，不強制該配比。

subjects.subject: 企業內部控制理論與實務(含相關法規)

sustainability.note: 證基會歷屆試題：115年第4次、114年第4次（含高雄考區）。依簡章：共一科，每回 80 題單選題，總分 100 分，以總分達 70 分為合格。
